title: Shift Swap Log Form
subtitle: Use this log to record events in sequence, reconcile sources, identify trends and exceptions, and transfer the last known status for a shift swap workflow.
description: An original operational shift swap log form that controls a paired schedule-change and coverage record from identity and routing through evidence, qualified decision, exception management, implementation, handoff, and final verification.
use_case: Use when the requesting workers, scheduler, or shift manager needs a traceable log so the authorized scheduling, payroll, operations, or HR reviewer can approve, conditionally approve, deny, cancel, reverse, or correct the proposed shift exchange under the current schedule, role-qualification matrix, rest and overtime rules, labor agreement, and applicable scheduling policy without relying on an informal email, spreadsheet, or unreviewed narrative.

sections.title: Shift Swap log period, ownership, and control
sections.guidance: Open a bounded log with a clear owner, source record, entry standard, and review cadence.

blocks.label: Shift Swap identity
Log ownership and routing
Log period and entry control

sections.title: Shift Swap baseline, entry rules, and expected evidence
sections.guidance: Define the expected operating state so each log entry can be interpreted later.

blocks.label: Shift Swap log-entry requirements
items: Both workers and their employee references are verified
Original shift dates, times, zones, roles, and locations match the schedule
Proposed segments account for the full exchanged time
Role qualifications, credentials, access, and supervision remain sufficient
Coverage and skill mix are maintained for both affected shifts
Rest, consecutive-work, fatigue, and scheduling limits are reviewed
Overtime, premium, differential, and labor-agreement impacts are calculated
Both workers provided voluntary, current acknowledgment
Conflicting leave, training, restriction, or assignment is resolved
Manager and scheduler approvals are captured before the effective time
Schedule and timekeeping systems show matching final assignments
Each worker received confirmation and the cancellation route

blocks.label: Supporting evidence and source records
items: Published original schedule and schedule-period reference
Worker identity, role, qualification, and access records
Paired worker acknowledgments with date and time
Coverage and skill-mix review
Rest, overtime, premium, or agreement-rule check
Manager, scheduler, or second-level decision
Updated scheduling and timekeeping system reference
Cancellation, no-show, correction, or payroll follow-up record

blocks.label: Opening status, carried items, data sources, known gaps, entry conventions, and review assumptions

sections.title: Shift Swap recurring event log
sections.guidance: Enter events in sequence and preserve actor, result, source, and next action.

blocks.label: Shift Swap event and status log
Decision, correction, status change, reason, and authorization log
Sequence context, corrected entry, source conflict, missing interval, and interpretation limit

sections.title: Shift Swap trend, reconciliation, and period review
sections.guidance: Reconcile the log to source systems and identify patterns that require a decision or corrective action.

blocks.label: Population, source count, log count, variance, owner, and resolution
Period review and decision checks
items: Original schedule segments exist and belong to the stated workers
Proposed worker is qualified for the location, role, task, and equipment
Required coverage, skill mix, supervision, and headcount remain intact
Rest, consecutive-day, fatigue, and scheduling limits were checked
Overtime, premium, differential, and labor-cost effects are known
Applicable notice, seniority, bidding, or agreement terms were reviewed
Both workers' consent is current, voluntary, and independently recorded
Conflicts with leave, training, restrictions, or other assignments are resolved
Scheduling and timekeeping systems can reflect the same approved segments
Cancellation and failed-handoff responsibilities are explicit

blocks.label: Period review outcome
Observed pattern, comparison basis, outlier, source limitation, operational effect, and decision need

sections.title: Shift Swap unresolved event and escalation register
sections.guidance: Preserve exceptions separately from routine entries until final disposition.

blocks.label: Log stop and escalation boundary
blocks.guidance: Pause any action outside documented authority. Protect privacy, preserve the original evidence, and route urgent, safety, security, retaliation, or legal concerns to the authorized scheduling, payroll, operations, or HR reviewer under the current schedule, role-qualification matrix, rest and overtime rules, labor agreement, and applicable scheduling policy.

blocks.label: Shift Swap exception and escalation triggers
items: Approved change was not entered or appeared differently in a system
Worker reported to the wrong time, role, unit, or location
No-show or uncovered interval followed the exchange
Worker lacked required qualification, access, or supervision
Rest, fatigue, overtime, premium, or agreement constraint was missed
Worker reports coercion, retaliation, side payment, or false consent
Cancellation or reversal was not communicated to every affected party
Timekeeping or payroll result does not match the approved schedule

blocks.label: Exception, immediate action, owner, due point, and disposition register
Exception facts, affected scope, privacy boundary, unresolved risk, and escalation rationale

sections.title: Shift Swap period handoff and log closeout
sections.guidance: Transfer the last known status, open actions, and next required review to the receiving owner.

blocks.label: Log outcome and handoff
Open shift swap action and limitation register
Closeout and recipient handoff confirmations
items: Final decision and effective boundary are recorded
Evidence supporting the outcome is linked and readable
Every unresolved action has an owner and due point
Sensitive information is routed only to the designated restricted record
Affected people and receiving systems received the necessary status
Conditions, limitations, and escalation triggers remain visible
Required payroll, schedule, access, asset, or workflow update is confirmed
Follow-up review or reopen condition has an accountable owner

blocks.label: Final evidence, decision rationale, remaining limitation, communication, and acceptance
Log accountable review
